settings.question: Are these official licensed jerseys?
settings.answer: Novora jerseys are premium fan-edition replicas — same look, colors and crests as match kits at a fraction of the price. They're not sold as licensed merchandise.

settings.question: How do I find my size?
settings.answer: Our jerseys are true to size with a standard athletic cut: S fits a 36" chest, M 40", L 44", XL 48", XXL 52". If you're between sizes or prefer a looser fit, size up.

settings.question: Can I add my own name and number?
settings.answer: Yes — free of charge. Add any name and number in official match fonts on the product page before checkout. Personalized jerseys are final sale.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: We dispatch within 48 hours with free tracked worldwide shipping. Most orders arrive in 7–12 business days depending on your country.

settings.question: Which nations can I order?
settings.answer: All 32 World Cup nations in both home and away kits. Popular nations like Argentina, Brazil, France and Portugal are always in stock.

settings.question: What if it doesn't fit?
settings.answer: Non-personalized jerseys can be returned within 30 days for a free size exchange or a full refund — no hassle.
